title: fix(app-shell): Studio page seed and slotted preview take the runtime detail sections (objectui#12442)
body:
Fixes #12442
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Studio's page-create seed and its slotted page preview now pass `buildDefaultPageSchema` the same detail sections the running app passes. Before, on an object with no `fieldGroups`, both built a bare `record:details`. Since PR #12441 a bare node draws only the object's `highlightFields`, or nothing. The running app draws every visible field, split into a primary section and a collapsible "More details" section.

- **One derivation.** The section derivation moved out of `RecordDetailView`'s `synthParts` memo into `packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.ts`. It moved verbatim. The only change is that the "More details" heading arrives as an argument, because a React hook resolves it.
  - `deriveRecordDetailSections`: the runtime calls it, unchanged in behaviour.
  - `deriveStudioDetailSections`: the seed and the preview call it. It returns `undefined` when the object's `fieldGroups` apply, so the synthesizer keeps writing its `{ group }` references (CONTROL: unchanged). Otherwise it returns `deriveRecordDetailSections` itself, not a copy.
  - `toAuthoredDetailSections`: the seed persists the sections with each field reduced to its name. That is the only `fields` spelling the spec's `RecordDetailsProps.sections[].fields` declares. `record:details` re-reads a named field's label, type and options from the object (`DetailSection`'s `enrichDetailField`).
- **The heading.** The preview resolves "More details" exactly as the runtime does (`sectionLabel` over `t('detail.sectionMoreDetails', 'More details')`). The seed has no translator, so it persists the English text. The section keeps `name: 'details'`, so the per-object `_sections.details` translation still applies.
- `isSecondaryField` and its two sets moved with the derivation. `RecordDetailView` re-exports it for `richtextSurfaceParity.test.tsx`.
- `resolveDetailSections`' doc said an omitted `sections` "falls back to its flat layout". It now says what a bare node draws (the object's `highlightFields`, else an empty body) and names the callers that pass the runtime body.

No published export changes: the new module is not re-exported from any package entry, so `Clause-②: no` stands. Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch (doc only).

## Measurements (dispatch assumptions)

- **A1 (a pure function):** partly true. The derivation reads only the object definition, plus one display string: the "More details" heading, which the runtime builds from two React hooks (`useObjectTranslation`, `useObjectLabel`). The helper takes that string as an argument. The preview supplies the same hooks. The seed supplies the English default (see Acceptance notes).
- **A2 (where it lives):** `packages/app-shell`. All three callers are there, and nothing in `plugin-detail` needed to own it.
- **A3 (pins and ablation):** done. See below.

## Tests (final head 3a78d8b42, after merging `origin/main`)

- New `recordDetailSections.agreement-12442.test.ts`, 7 cases, real `createSeed`, no `vi.mock`:
  - an object with no `fieldGroups`: the seed's `record:details` carries the runtime sections in their persisted shape, `[name, subject, priority, account]` plus `[notes]` under "More details";
  - those seeded sections parse under `RecordDetailsProps`;
  - the seed's node equals the node the synthesizer builds from the runtime sections;
  - CONTROL: an object with `fieldGroups` seeds regions equal to `buildDefaultPageSchema(def)` alone, the `{ group }` reference form;
  - a source pin: the runtime calls `deriveRecordDetailSections`, and the seed and the preview call `deriveStudioDetailSections`. None of the three keeps a copy of the split.
- `PagePreview.test.tsx`, two new cases: on an object with no `fieldGroups` the slotted preview's `record:details` carries exactly `deriveRecordDetailSections`' output. CONTROL: a grouped object previews exactly what the synthesizer alone writes.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` over the agreement file, `metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview*`, `metadata-admin/anchors*`, `richtextSurfaceParity.test.tsx` and `RecordDetailView.sectionHeadingsRenderPath-6190.test.tsx` (the runtime's rendered headings, with and without `fieldGroups`): Test Files 12 passed (12); Tests 75 passed (75); exit 0.
- Under the verify lock at 3a78d8b42: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (both new test files are in the `tsconfig.test.json` program, checked with `--listFiles`); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` exit 0.

## Ablations (`objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode; each anchor went 1 to 0, and each restore was blob-equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`)

- **AB1, the preview call site reverted** (`deriveStudioDetailSections(...)` replaced by `undefined`). Predicted: the preview's no-`fieldGroups` case and the source pin go red, everything else stays green. Measured: 2 failed / 13 passed, exactly those two.
- **AB2, the seed call site reverted.** Predicted: the seed case, the node-equality case and the source pin go red; the spec-parse case stays green because an absent `sections` parses too. Measured: 3 failed / 12 passed, exactly those three. Because AB2 showed the spec-parse case was vacuous on its own, that case now asserts the seeded sections exist before parsing (commit e017d0148).

## Gates (exit codes captured before any pipe, at 3a78d8b42)

- Exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 8 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 7 changed TS files: 7 files, 0 errors, 224 warnings, all `no-explicit-any`. Per file, base to head: `RecordDetailView.tsx` 109 to 104 (the moved block), `anchors.ts` 5 to 7, `PagePreview.tsx` 15 to 16, `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` 62 to 62. The new module has 8 and the tests have their own. The population is eslint's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- NOT MEASURED: the wider lock run (all of `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` plus every `RecordDetailView*` suite). Three 9-minute tries each answered `queue-timeout` behind another seat's full `app-shell/src/views/` run, so the narrowed set above stands in. CI runs the farm.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure` (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads a built console bundle). `RecordDetailView` already imports the new module statically, and the seed reaches it through a dynamic import beside its existing `@object-ui/plugin-detail` one. CI measures it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The seeded heading is English.** A seed is persisted metadata and has no translator, so it writes "More details" with `name: 'details'`. A tenant with a per-object `_sections.details` translation sees that. Otherwise, in a non-English locale, a seeded page reads "More details" where the default page reads the shell's translation. Carrier: none.
- **A grouped object's seed still differs from the runtime**, by this card's CONTROL ruling. The seed writes `{ group, columns }` plus one untitled ungrouped bucket. The runtime writes `{ group, showBorder: true }` and splits the ungrouped bucket into primary plus "More details". This is read in code, not measured at a public door. Carrier: none.
- **File surface:** besides the `synthParts` derivation, `RecordDetailView.tsx` changed in two places: the `isSecondaryField` block moved out and is re-exported, and two imports the moved code used were dropped. Both come from moving the derivation. The page-header overflow entry that PR #12443 edits is untouched.
